question: An instrument that can detect the presence of a current in a circuit is known as ________.
solution: The correct answer is __**ammeter.**__ __** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__** __ • ** An ammeter is a device that measures electric current in a circuit.** • It is connected in series with the circuit and measures the **flow of current through it.** • An ammeter is designed to have a very low resistance so that it does not affect the current flowing through the circuit. • It is an essential tool for anyone working with electrical circuits, as it helps in monitoring the current and detecting any faults or abnormalities. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • ** Odometer: **It is an instrument that measures the distance traveled by a vehicle. • ** Speedometer:** It is an instrument that measures the speed of a vehicle. • **Hygrometer:** It is an instrument that measures the humidity in the atmosphere.
